name: sparx — Yoga Studio
tagline: A warm, all-levels template for yoga studios — a live class schedule from day one.
description: A warm, grounded yoga-studio site — a terracotta-and-clay palette over a cream ground, a soft sage accent and humanist type. Installs a live class schedule with capacity: vinyasa, yin, hot, restorative, foundations and prenatal, each a bookable class with a drop-in price, plus four teachers and two studio rooms (including a hot room) as bookable resources with weekly hours. Ships as "Prana", an all-levels studio where you belong wherever you’re starting.
